form: # The spelling list of the Schola Thomistica corpus (scholathomistica.com/handbook, Latin orthography). It is exscriptor's default list: `expand run`, `house apply`, `house screen` and `preflight` read it, and `--spelling-map` replaces it for a project with its own policy. It grows by pull request; CONTRIBUTING.md says what a row must satisfy. Every expand record and preflight report names the sha of the list it used.

# form: the print's spelling, as the beginning of a word, matched in any case, and a changed word keeps its capitals (CHARITAS becomes CARITAS); a trailing $ means the whole word only; a form with a capital matches only that form and its capitals (a name: Sylvius and SYLVIUS are kept). A name the list would change is kept by the work's editor.
# edition: the form the edition writes. A row whose edition equals its form keeps that form; the longest matching form decides (coetern keeps coeternus, though coeter becomes ceter).

# A pair row, edition `majority`, names two spellings that are both legitimate (form `a$|b$`; a side `-x` is an ending, as in -cunque|-cumque): each work writes the one its print uses more often, a tie keeps the first. Nothing is imposed across works.

# tier 1: a printer's spelling, classicized (the standard is Lewis & Short, its first spelling of the headword). tier 2: a scholastic or ecclesiastical spelling, kept. Counts (CT, Vatican) are from a 2026-10-30 sample of 231,328 words of Corpus Thomisticum and 153,836 words of vatican.va Latin; "corpus" counts are the Schola Thomistica corpus lexicon of 2026-11-06.
